title: 第0017章 大肆采购收获颇丰第0018章 安全返回周通再现
slug: 五灵根修炼慢我有百倍灵药空间
content_zh:
;;
此时的陆青禾出现在一座豪华的铺面面前，灵药阁，这在仙坊之中算是比较庞大的几个势力了。
毕竟丹药是每个修士趋之若鹜的修炼资源，丹药是陆青禾这次的目的之一。
陆青禾一步踏进了灵药阁。
陆青禾才踏进灵药阁，一个侍女走来，对着陆青禾询问：“道友，你需要购买什么丹药？”
陆青禾首先问道：“你们这里收购灵药吗？”
侍女愣了一下，没有想到陆青禾竟然是来售卖灵药的。
侍女点头：“质量不错的灵药我们都收。”
“道友想卖什么灵药？”
陆青禾将两个玉盒拿了出来，每一个玉盒都是一株五十年份的血参。
看到血参侍女眼睛一亮：“竟然是五十年份的血参，足够在炼制中品上品丹药中使用。”
陆青禾问道：“不知道灵药阁可以给多少灵石进行收购？”
侍女思考了一下：“正好灵药阁要炼制一炉黄龙丹，需要血参，这样五十年份的血参，每一株灵药阁可以给三十灵石收购。”
陆青禾一惊，他原本认为五十年份的血参价值二十灵石就不错了，没有想到竟然能够给出三十灵石的高价。
看陆青禾没有回答，侍女说到：“道友，这是灵药阁能够给出最高的价格了，也绝对是青云仙坊最高的价格。
到别的地方道友可能只能卖25灵石。”
“成交！”
陆青禾将两株血参卖给了灵药阁，价值60灵石，但是陆青禾并没有拿灵石。
而是开口对着侍女问道：“灵药阁聚灵丹多少一瓶？”
侍女微笑回答：“十灵石一瓶。”

这价格比外面要贵一点，但是胜在灵药阁的丹药品质要比其他地方的好一些。
“全部给我换成聚灵丹。”
“好的！”
侍女走到柜台上，拿了六瓶聚灵丹递给了陆青禾。
陆青禾打开丹药瓶，扑鼻的香味扑面而来，确定丹药无误。
“多谢！”
侍女露出迷人的笑容：“以后道友还有这样年份的血参或者是购买灵丹，希望来灵药阁，一定会让道友满意的。”
“一定，告辞！”
陆青禾急忙带着丹药离开了。
陆青禾离开，侍女收起血参玉盒：“五十年份的血参，希望能够增加阁老炼丹成功率。”
陆青禾没有继续进行售卖，他继续走进几个店铺，购买他需要的物品。
首先花费了一百灵石，购买了十瓶聚灵丹，加上之前的六瓶，总共十六瓶距离，足够他修炼一段时间了。
甚至是直接修到炼气四层也不是不可能的事情。
其次是到灵符店铺，购买了两张高级灵符，一张冰符，能够冰住炼气后期修士的灵符，陆青禾花费了八十灵石。
还有一张更为恐怖的雷符，能够灭杀炼气后期的恐怖符箓，但是价格也比同等的高级灵符高很多，让他花费了120灵石。

At this time, Lu Qinghe appeared in front of a luxurious shop, the Spiritual Medicine Pavilion, which was considered one of the relatively large forces in the Immortal Workshop.
After all, elixirs are a cultivation resource that every monk is eager for, and elixirs are one of Lu Qinghe's goals this time.
Lu Qinghe stepped into the Spiritual Medicine Pavilion.
Lu Qinghe just stepped into the Spiritual Medicine Pavilion when a maid came over and asked Lu Qinghe: "Fellow Taoist, what pills do you need to buy?"
Lu Qinghe first asked: "Do you buy elixirs here?"
The maid was stunned for a moment, not expecting that Lu Qinghe was here to sell elixirs.
The maid nodded: "We accept all elixirs of good quality."
"What elixir do you want to sell, fellow Taoist?"
Lu Qinghe took out two jade boxes. Each jade box contained a fifty-year-old blood ginseng.
The maid's eyes lit up when she saw the blood ginseng: "It turns out to be fifty-year-old blood ginseng, enough to be used in refining middle-grade and top-grade elixirs."
Lu Qinghe asked: "I wonder how many spiritual stones the Spiritual Medicine Pavilion can give for purchase?"
The maid thought for a moment: "It just so happens that the Spiritual Medicine Pavilion needs blood ginseng to refine a furnace of Huanglong Dan. In this way, each fifty-year-old blood ginseng can be purchased by the Spiritual Medicine Pavilion for thirty spiritual stones."
Lu Qinghe was shocked. He originally thought that fifty-year-old blood ginseng would be worth twenty spiritual stones, but he did not expect that he could be given a high price of thirty spiritual stones.
Seeing that Lu Qinghe didn't answer, the maid said: "Fellow Taoist, this is the highest price that the Spiritual Medicine Pavilion can offer, and it is definitely the highest price that Qingyun Immortal Square can offer.
Taoist friends in other places may only be able to sell 25 spiritual stones. "
"Deal!"
Lu Qinghe sold two blood ginseng plants to the Spiritual Medicine Pavilion, worth 60 spirit stones, but Lu Qinghe did not take the spirit stones.
Instead, he turned to the maid and asked, "How many bottles of Ling Yao Pavilion's Spirit Gathering Pill are there?"
The maid smiled and replied: "Ten spiritual stones in one bottle."
The price is a bit more expensive than outside, but the quality of the elixirs in Lingyao Pavilion is better than those in other places.
"Replace them all with Spirit Gathering Pills."
"Okay!"
The maid walked to the counter, took six bottles of Spirit Gathering Pills and handed them to Lu Qinghe.
Lu Qinghe opened the elixir bottle, and the tangy fragrance hit his nostrils, confirming that the elixir was correct.
"Thank you!"
The maid showed a charming smile: "In the future, my Taoist friend will still have blood ginseng of this age or buy elixirs. I hope that I will be satisfied with my visit to the Spiritual Medicine Pavilion."
"Definitely, farewell!"
Lu Qinghe hurriedly took the elixir and left.
Lu Qinghe left, and the maid put away the jade box of blood ginseng: "The fifty-year-old blood ginseng, I hope it can increase the success rate of Ge Lao's alchemy."
Lu Qinghe did not continue selling. He continued to walk into several stores to buy the items he needed.
First, he spent a hundred spirit stones to buy ten bottles of spirit-gathering pills. Adding the previous six bottles, the total distance was sixteen bottles, which was enough for him to practice for a period of time.
Even cultivating directly to the fourth level of Qi Refining is not impossible.
Next, he went to the spiritual talisman shop and bought two high-level spiritual talismans and an ice talisman, which can freeze the spiritual talisman of monks in the late stage of Qi refining. Lu Qinghe spent eighty spiritual stones.
There was also a more terrifying thunder talisman, which could kill the terrifying talisman in the later stages of Qi refining, but the price was much higher than the equivalent high-level spiritual talisman, costing him 120 spirit stones.
